head: 10 new photo and video apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These camera and editing apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Photo & Video charts this week, from film-look cameras and a VHS camcorder to a teleprompter and a RAW editor.
where: iPhone (some also iPad), US App Store Photo & Video charts (paid) this week
means: If your iPhone photos all look the same, these are the new camera and editing apps people in the US are paying for right now, all with a one-time price.
todo: Check the App Store page for your iPhone model first: Frame shoots 48 MP ProRAW only where the iPhone supports it, and AVANT CAMERA's Apple Log works on compatible devices.

list.name: Very Good Camera
list.what: A camera app built on Very Good Co.'s film color grades: VG400, VG800 for low light and VGTX for black and white, with manual exposure and RAW files.

list.name: VHS Camcorder: 90s Retro Cam
list.what: Records video with the look of six old cameras, from a 1994 camcorder to Super 8 and night vision, with the look recorded into the file as you shoot.

list.name: Monochrome Lab
list.what: A black-and-white camera and photo editor that previews the look live, shoots JPEG or RAW and edits without changing the original.

list.name: DIITR - Dithering Camera
list.what: A camera that turns photos and videos into dotted pixel patterns as you shoot, with 11 dithering styles and your own colors.

list.name: 2Seconds Daily
list.what: Makes a film of your life from one short clip per day and can fill in past days from your photo library.

list.name: TruePrompter: Teleprompter
list.what: A teleprompter for iPhone and iPad that floats over the Camera app and social apps and scrolls along with your voice.

list.name: Frame: Pro Camera
list.what: A camera that shoots RAW, 48 MP ProRAW where the iPhone supports it, with three film looks made by London photographer WAVO.

list.name: AVANT CAMERA
list.what: A video camera app that shows film-style color live while you record, with Apple Log on compatible iPhones.

list.name: BurstReel
list.what: Turns a burst of photos into a short video at 1 to 60 photos per second, with loops and 1080p export.

list.name: Recipe Lab Studio: RAW Editor
list.what: Develops RAW photos from your camera on your phone, brought in over Wi-Fi or from Photos, with film looks and grain; one payment, no subscription.
